{"args":["-c","import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from clock import expired, as_utc
from cache import Cache
n=datetime(2024,1,1,12,0,0); tz=timezone(timedelta(hours=2))
# boundary + naive/aware
assert expired(n,n) and not expired(n+timedelta(microseconds=1),n)
assert expired(n, datetime(2024,1,1,14,0,0,tzinfo=tz))
assert not expired(datetime(2024,1,1,14,0,1,tzinfo=tz), n)
assert expired(datetime(2024,1,1,12,0,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc), n)
# cache
c=Cache(); c.put('a',1,n+timedelta(seconds=1))
assert c.get('a',n)==1
c.get('a',n)
try: c.get('a',n+timedelta(seconds=1)); raise AssertionError
except KeyError: pass
assert 'a' not in c.entries
try: c.get('zz',n); raise AssertionError
except KeyError: pass
# aware entry live via aware now
c.put('b',2,datetime(2024,1,1,14,0,1,tzinfo=tz))
assert c.get('b',n)==2
shutil.rmtree('__pycache__',ignore_errors=True)
print('all checks ok')
"],"environment_names":[],"max_output_bytes":1048576,"program":"python3","timeout_seconds":120}
